report.summary: 4 confirmed/narrowed findings: human-bytes-bug (medium), available-vendors-incomplete (critical), error-return-shape-mismatch (high), egress-gate-unenforced (high). root-path-inconsistency (low) is fragile but low urgency.
risks: available-vendors-incomplete is critical: missing implementation blocks vendor discovery
error-return-shape-mismatch may cause StopIteration crash in lint.py
egress-gate-unenforced may allow unintended content leakage
human-bytes-bug misrepresents very large sizes, but severity is medium
todos: Fix _human_bytes to return PiB for sizes >= 1024 TiB
Add 'matches' field to all SearchReport returns in embeddings.py
Wire _emit_ok calls in slice.py to enforce egress gates
Document root path fragility with a comment

items.title: Implement available_vendors function in vendors.py
items.why_now: Critical: the function is missing, breaking vendor discovery and any code that depends on it.

steps.do: Open daedalus/council/vendors.py and implement available_vendors to return a list of available vendor names based on configured providers.
steps.verified_by: Import the module and call available_vendors() to confirm it returns a list.

items.assumption: The full vendors.py file exists and the function is indeed missing; the index shows available_vendors is listed in __all__ but the implementation may be elsewhere.

items.title: Fix _human_bytes to return PiB for sizes >= 1024 TiB
items.why_now: Bug causes misrepresentation of very large byte sizes; affects any code using this function for large values.

steps.do: Edit daedalus/observe/shape.py: modify _human_bytes to allow unit progression beyond TiB to PiB.

items.assumption: The function _human_bytes is in observe/shape.py as per the index.

items.title: Ensure all SearchReport returns include 'matches' field
items.why_now: Prevents StopIteration crash in lint.py when compare() expects 'matches' key.

steps.do: Inspect lines 1499-1503 in daedalus/memory/embeddings.py and add 'matches' field to any SearchReport lacking it.
steps.verified_by: Run lint.py compare() on a report that previously lacked 'matches' and confirm no StopIteration.

items.assumption: Lines 1499-1503 exist and are the ones returning SearchReport without matches; the cited source excerpt does not include them.

items.title: Wire _emit_ok calls in slice.py to enforce egress gates
items.why_now: Without calls to _emit_ok, egress gates are not enforced, potentially allowing unintended content leakage.

steps.do: Search daedalus/structcore/slice.py for calls to _emit_ok; add calls where needed to enforce egress gates.
steps.verified_by: grep -n '_emit_ok' daedalus/structcore/slice.py should show calls in emission paths.

items.assumption: _emit_ok is defined but not called; the full file may contain calls not shown in the provided chunk.

items.title: Document root path fragility with comment
items.why_now: Low severity but prevents future breakage if directory structure changes.

steps.do: Add a comment in daedalus/memory/__init__.py and daedalus/spine/ledger.py noting the assumption about directory depth.
Add a comment in daedalus/spine/ledger.py noting the assumption about directory depth.

items.assumption: Both files use parents[2] and are at the same depth; the comment will warn future developers.
